rescrybed.title: RESCRYBED
rescrybed.desc:
An Inscryption Act 2 + Act 3 inspired card game, but with custom cards. Expect many bugs as the game is actively being fixed.

Draft a deck of 15 cards from the random choices offered to you, then battle it out in a Best of 5 format! Use robotic creatures and empower them with modules to take down your opponent! Talk to Evelyn to queue up, the rest is self-explanatory.

Bunch of assets such as certain theme backgrounds were taken directly from the original, credits go to their respective owners.
credits: mmmmmonster - game designer, concepts, balancing, some visuals
